items.title: Arthur Vigne Interview, 1961-11-29
items.q: Then he had a friend, I think you might have heard of his friend, Cantrell. Oh yes, Louis Cantrell.

ctx.x: Did he usually like to play a snare drum or the bass drum in those marching bands?

In the marching bands he always did play the bass drum. Yeah he used to like hit the four raps on those fellas. Yeah he used to play the bass drum in the funerals but in the cabarets he played both, you know the combination. Then he had a friend, I think you might have heard of his friend, Cantrell. Oh yes, Louis Cantrell.
His son is still playing now.
